steps.name: Prepare the sender's half of the Bell pair
Entangle the sender's q1 with the receiver's q2
Prepare a message with a 25% chance of reading 1
Give the message's |1> amplitude a relative phase of +i
Write the bit parity of the sender's pair onto q1
Use q1 to control the X correction on the receiver
Use q0 to control the Z correction and restore the message phase
